S1_command_classification.red_before: classifyCommand('cd /repo && helm template kc .helm/roz') === '' while classifyCommand('helm template kc .helm/roz') === 'helm template'
S1_command_classification.repair: The classifier now reads the command line as a sequence of quote-aware shell SEGMENTS and classifies the executable of the segment that carries the work. The `cd` prefix is recognised as a DIRECTORY CHANGE and never contributes a classification.
invariants_preserved: The carried value is ALWAYS a finite-allowlist entry; the allowlist was NOT widened.
No user-supplied path, argument, URL or credential is ever carried.
The classifier is NOT a shell: an ambiguous segment carries NOTHING.
The `cd` segment's argument is a path and is never carried.

fail_closed_rules_added.pipeline: A `|` pipeline carries nothing. The shell's exit status of a pipeline is its LAST element's status, so a successful wrapper does not establish that the earlier element succeeded (the R1 failure shape).
fail_closed_rules_added.or_chain: A `||` chain carries nothing: the second segment runs only when the first one FAILED, so which segment ran is not decidable from the text.
fail_closed_rules_added.multiple_allowlisted_executables: A chain naming MORE THAN ONE allowlisted executable carries nothing.
fail_closed_rules_added.ambiguous_characters: Command substitution (`$`, backtick — also inside double quotes), grouping (`(`, `)`, `{`, `}`), redirection (`>`, `<`), backgrounding (`&`), globbing/tilde (`*`, `?`, `[`, `]`, `~`) and history expansion (`!`) make a segment ambiguous.
fail_closed_rules_added.quoted_operators_are_data: A quoted region is inert data: `helm template 'a && b'` still classifies as `helm template`.

S2_compaction_accounting.review_finding_confirmed: The RECON02 counterexample compares two hand-supplied representations through a LOCALLY DEFINED `shouldCompactOn` helper (compaction.roundc-fidelity-recon02.test.ts:1128-1137). It never drives the production trigger.
S2_compaction_accounting.production_source_fact_1: The compaction trigger's request-size decision reads `context.apiMessages`, not `context.messages` (compaction.ts:381-389).
S2_compaction_accounting.production_source_fact_2: The production orchestrator populates `context.apiMessages` with the API-SAFE PROJECTION before the trigger reads it: session-runtime-orchestrator.ts:1775 -> prepareProviderMessagesForApi (:1846-1856) -> MessageBuilder.buildForApi.
S2_compaction_accounting.consequence: The upstream v4.1.26 correction (43a976d93151) is present on BOTH the first-compaction and re-compaction paths in this fork. The raw representation the counterexample compares against is not a representation the production trigger can observe.
S2_compaction_accounting.withdrawn_claim: The ten live compactions were unjustified. This is NOT ESTABLISHED: the decision-request accounting is UNAVAILABLE_FROM_TRACE and the preceding provider request is an ADJACENT-REQUEST PROXY, not the decision request.
S2_compaction_accounting.live_axis_not_exonerated: The estimator's 3-chars-per-token assumption under-counting token-dense bodies remains a separate, live and unmeasured axis. It is the most likely remaining candidate.
S2_compaction_accounting.precondition_for_any_future_repair: Matched decision-time evidence: capture the request estimate, the API-projection estimate, the trigger, the calibration factor and the request identity through the existing compaction diagnostics (default-off, metadata-only), and reproduce a mismatch through the ACTUAL runtime projection rather than a manually supplied raw view.
S2_compaction_accounting.permanent_discriminator: sdk/packages/core/src/extensions/context/compaction.trigger-accounting-representation.test.ts (6 tests) pins the representation the trigger actually measures and states explicitly what it does NOT establish.

result_bodies_omitted.correction: The 487 figure is a measurement of the RECONSTRUCTED full prefix (serializeConversation(prefix)), NOT a verified count of bodies omitted from the ACTUAL HISTORICAL SUMMARIZER REQUEST. The real pipeline selects `previousSummary + newMessagesToFold`, applies the budget projection, and only then serializes. The exact historical request remains UNAVAILABLE_FROM_TRACE.

R1_helm_render.correction: The wrapper status (SUCCESS_WRAPPER) and the render outcome (FAILED, rc=1, Go-template error) are DISTINCT facts. `approved_fact_r1_helm_render_succeeded.in_canonical_history` was a false-positive `true` and is now `false`; the RENDER_ATTEMPTED marker is separated from RENDER_SUCCEEDED and RENDER_FAILED.
R1_helm_render.recovered_classification_does_not_certif: Recovering `helm template` as a CLASSIFICATION must not be read as proof that the render succeeded. The carried evidence records the tool's own success signal; it never upgrades a wrapper status into a render outcome.
